documents.population: International applicants to undergraduate programmes (Chinese-taught and English-taught)
documents.notes: International College of Zhejiang University undergraduate application guide (the page's dates are the 2026 cycle's: passport valid after 1 March 2027, admission notices from end of June 2026, registration September 2026). Not drafted (no vocabulary kind): HSK certificate or certificate of Chinese-language instruction (Chinese-taught programmes), award certificates (if applicable), nationality documents for former Chinese citizens, Letter of Guardian Guarantee (under 18), signed Commitments form. Optional international/national test results are not drafted because entrance_test is the required CSCA report.

items.quote: Applicants must log in to the Online Application System for International Students of Zhejiang University, fill in clearly and upload completely the following materials as required.
Senior high school diploma. Graduating students should provide pre-graduation certificate or student status certificate issued by current school.
Academic transcripts for all the courses in senior high school.
Score r eport of China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) .
Applicants for English-taught programs must provide score report of English language test (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/OTHER) , if their native language is not English .
items.condition: English-taught programme and native language not English

items.quote: Personal statement, includ ing study experience, reasons for application, personal strengths ,about 800 words.
Two recommendation letters, in principle from high school teachers .
The above application materials must be in Chinese or English, and notarized copies of translations must be provided for texts in other languages along with the original copy .
items.condition: a document is in a language other than Chinese or English
